department: College of Earth, Ocean, and Atmospheric Sciences (CEOAS)

deadline.value: The CEOAS on-campus application deadline for Fall admission is December 15, 2026, and it applies to all majors.
deadline.quote: The CEOAS on-campus graduate programs application deadline is December 15, 2026 for all majors

gre_general.value: The GRE is no longer required for CEOAS programs.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is no longer required.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Faculty must agree to be research mentors for accepted students, so admission depends on finding one.
supervisor.quote: individual faculty members must agree to be research mentors (major professors) for accepted students

funding.value: The page says support is offered but does not say that all or most PhD students are funded.

entry_route.value: Students can be admitted to either the master's or the doctoral program; some are admitted to the PhD without a master's, case by case.
entry_route.quote: Some programs will admit to PhD without a prior master's degree, but this is on a case-by-case basis.

notes: Covers the Ocean, Earth and Atmospheric Sciences graduate programs for all majors; the deadline quote is in the page's Fall-admissions paragraph. The page's own prose has a Fall 2026 date for the cycle; the 2026-12-15 date is for Fall 2027 entry.
